content.value_statement: Teams need accurate changes when moving prompts and API calls to Claude Opus 4.5. This skill guides model string updates, beta header cleanup, effort settings, and optional prompt adjustments.
actual_capabilities: Finds supported Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model strings.
Maps supported source model strings to Claude Opus 4.5 identifiers for major platforms.
Guides removal of the unsupported 1M context beta header for Opus 4.5.
Points users to high effort configuration when effort migration is requested.
Provides optional prompt snippets for tool use, code exploration, frontend quality, and reasoning wording.
Summarizes model, prompt, beta header, and effort changes after migration.
limitations: Does not run tests or confirm runtime API behavior by itself.
Applies prompt snippets only when a user reports a matching issue.
Requires user review for cost, latency, and quality changes after migration.

use_cases.title: Upgrade API Integrations
use_cases.description: Update application model identifiers and related beta headers for Opus 4.5 requests.

use_cases.title: Tune Agent Prompts
use_cases.description: Adjust prompts only when Opus 4.5 shows tool overuse, shallow code review, or generic frontend output.

use_cases.title: Review Platform Coverage
use_cases.description: Check Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry model strings before rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Model Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to migrate my project from Claude Sonnet 4.5 to Claude Opus 4.5. Update supported model strings and summarize each change.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Beta Headers
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find Opus 4.5 migration changes. Remove unsupported 1M context beta headers, preserve unrelated settings, and explain what changed.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Targeted Prompt Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt adjustment after a behavior issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to update our agent prompt for Opus 4.5. The model is calling tools too often, so apply only the matching prompt guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multi-Platform Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review our Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure model references. Migrate supported sources to Opus 4.5 and flag unsupported cases.

output_examples.input: Migrate an Anthropic API app from Claude Sonnet 4.5 to Claude Opus 4.5.
output_examples.output: The skill reports updated Opus 4.5 model names, removed unsupported beta usage, added effort guidance when requested, and summarized changed files.

output_examples.input: Review a prompt after Opus 4.5 starts using tools too often.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends softening tool-triggering language, preserving unrelated prompt sections, and listing only the targeted prompt edits.

output_examples.input: Check a multi-cloud deployment before switching to Opus 4.5.
output_examples.output: The skill compares provider-specific model identifiers, flags unsupported Haiku migration requests, and produces a concise rollout checklist.

best_practices: Start with model string updates before changing prompt behavior.
Keep a short summary of every file and prompt change.
Run integration tests after changing model identifiers and beta headers.
anti_patterns: Applying every prompt snippet without a reported issue.
Migrating Haiku models with this skill.
Leaving unsupported beta headers enabled for Opus 4.5 requests.

faq.question: Which source models does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Claude Sonnet 4.0, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Opus 4.1. It does not migrate Haiku 4.5.

faq.question: Does it change prompts automatically?
faq.answer: By default, it updates model strings only. It applies prompt snippets only when a user reports a specific issue.

faq.question: Which platforms are included?
faq.answer: The guide includes Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry model strings.

faq.question: Does it configure effort settings?
faq.answer: It points to effort guidance and recommends high effort when the user requests effort configuration.

faq.question: Does this skill require code execution?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides migration instructions and reference snippets; it does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Can it verify production behavior?
faq.answer: No. Users should run their own tests after migration to confirm cost, latency, and response quality.
